chunks: And We gave him Isaac and Jacob, each of them We guided; and Noah, We guided before; and of his descendants, David and Solomon and Job and Joseph and Moses and Aaron. Thus We reward the doers of good.

key_terms.الْمُحْسِنِينَ: The doers of good / Those who excel in virtue

ai.seo_question: Who are the prophets mentioned in Surah Al-An'am verse 84 as being guided by God?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse highlights the continuity of divine guidance through the Ahl al-Bayt, specifically linking the prophetic lineage of Abraham to the Imams who inherit this spiritual authority. The term 'al-muhsinin' is often interpreted not merely as general doers of good, but as those who follow the specific guidance of the Prophet and his purified progeny, emphasizing the Shia concept of Imamate as the practical manifestation of divine reward.
